    "Search Field keeps an accessible name via its label prop.",
    "Search Field clear control needs an aria-label of \"Clear search\" or equivalent when shown.",
    "Empty State actions must be real actionable controls with accessible names.",
    "Announce the no-results Empty State once from the parent results region; Empty State has no automatic live region, and do not add a duplicate live region on Search Field."

  "assumptions": [
    "Recipe search-no-results applies to a post-query zero-match outcome, not first-use or validation errors.",
    "Empty State no-results intent is expressed with documented title/description/actions props; variant is not in empty-state api.properties so no variant prop is used.",
    "Recipe componentMaturity is containsBeta because Empty State is beta."
  ],
  "unresolvedGaps": [
    "Neither search-field nor empty-state is installableViaSkrewwwRegistry; components exist in Skrewww but no @skrewww install command is claimed.",
    "If Empty State's beta status is unacceptable for the product, stop and ask rather than substituting a custom empty div."
  ],
  "implementation": "Keep Search Field as search chrome (label, showClear, onValueChange, error). When a query yields no matches, render Empty State below with title/description and optional primaryAction/secondaryAction for recovery. Report Search Field as stable and Empty State as beta (recipe containsBeta). Do not invent a combined SearchResults component, Search Field empty slot, filter APIs, variant={no-results}, or install commands. Parent may announce the empty outcome once via aria-live."
}
